annotations.title: Check which EU/UK representative obligations apply

description: Checks, from a few facts about the company, whether it legally needs an EU GDPR Art. 27 representative, a UK GDPR Art. 27 representative and/or a GPSR Art. 16 EU responsible person, explains why with the legal basis and lists exemptions. Recommends the cheapest REP27 combination. Returns result_url, a personal page with the result.

currency.description: Currency to also show prices in: EUR, USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, NZD, CHF, CZK, JPY or NOK (ECB rate)
currency.title: Currency

data_requests_per_year.description: Expected data-subject requests per year (access, erasure…), 0 if unknown
data_requests_per_year.title: Data Requests Per Year

established_in.description: Country where the company is established, name or ISO code (e.g. United States, US, China)
established_in.title: Established In

has_eu_branch.description: True if the company has an establishment (branch or subsidiary) in the EU
has_eu_branch.title: Has Eu Branch

has_eu_importer_or_manufacturer_in_eu.description: True if an EU-based manufacturer, importer or authorised representative already covers the products
has_eu_importer_or_manufacturer_in_eu.title: Has Eu Importer Or Manufacturer In Eu

has_uk_branch.description: True if the company has an establishment in the UK
has_uk_branch.title: Has Uk Branch

health_or_special_category_data.description: True if it processes health or other special-category data (Art. 9) or criminal-offence data at scale
health_or_special_category_data.title: Health Or Special Category Data

lang.description: Language code for the answer (ISO 639-1, e.g. en, it, es, fr, de, pt, nl, pl, ja, zh)
lang.title: Lang

occasional_low_risk_processing_only.description: True if personal data of EU/UK people is processed only occasionally, at low risk and without special categories (Art. 27(2) exemption)
occasional_low_risk_processing_only.title: Occasional Low Risk Processing Only

offers_to_eu.description: True if the company offers goods or services to people in the EU/EEA or monitors their behaviour (tracking, ad profiling)
offers_to_eu.title: Offers To Eu

offers_to_uk.description: True if the company offers goods or services to people in the UK or monitors their behaviour
offers_to_uk.title: Offers To Uk

public_authority.description: True if the organisation is a public authority or body
public_authority.title: Public Authority

sells_consumer_products_eu.description: True if it places physical consumer products on the EU market (own shop or marketplaces like Amazon, Etsy, eBay)
sells_consumer_products_eu.title: Sells Consumer Products Eu

sells_consumer_products_uk.description: True if it places physical consumer products on the UK market
sells_consumer_products_uk.title: Sells Consumer Products Uk
